description: Save the definition of one call into your own system that the tester may make during a run (for example "create a voucher"). This only stores the definition: it sends no request itself. The tester sees only the name, the description and what the call returned. bodyTemplate may contain {{param}} placeholders the tester fills in. Headers (for example Authorization) are encrypted and never returned. Reference: https://testsy.dev/docs/mcp/

name.description: Short name (up to 40 characters), for example create_voucher
